basis: Private read-only supplement proposal from exact current source. Not dispatched, integrated, translated, or approved.
scope: Second bounded UI batch: exact quoted full messages, warnings, field dimensions and accessibility strings omitted by the first JSX segment inventory. Original templates are deferred until whole-message source design.
sourceEnglishConvention: String values are exact cooked TS literals. Template strings contain their exact source interior with original ${expression} tokens, which are recorded explicitly. sourceSha256 hashes UTF-8 sourceEnglish; occurrence hashes additionally pin exact TS expression bytes.
limits: JSX sentence fragments in the original 97 still require future whole-message source design.
Imported country labels, month/catalogue names, forecast child-component text, and propagated lib/bed-block errors are outside this supplement.
Do not dispatch template entries without reviewing how nested translated branches will be resolved.
Fifteen raw template interiors were deliberately excluded from this dispatchable subset; no runtime variable-expression names are translator placeholders.
